sectionHeadings: 010: Adopt the node lifecycle and the split-brain observation path
B-1. Startup is a fixed order, and most of it is not recoverable
B-2. A node's listen address is its own host plus its peers' idea of its port
B-3. Node identity is resolved two different ways
B-4. A pristine node 1 initializes itself, and checks first that it should
B-5. Every other node joins as learner, then as voter, and waits for both to replicate
B-6. `AppState` is the process-wide node state, and two flags gate readiness
B-7. Background tasks are spawned and owned by nobody
B-8. The split-brain checker observes, and reports only to the log
8. The inventory declarations this spec requires
record.summary: Adopts what a hiqlite node does between process start and process exit: the startup order, how a node resolves its own identity and listen addresses, how a fresh node 1 initializes, how every other node joins as learner and then voter, what the reset escape hatch destroys, which background tasks are spawned and owned by nobody, and what the split-brain checker observes. Six defects are recorded, four of them new and two executed. Documents HQL_SPLIT_BRAIN_INTERVAL, closing F-011. Repairs no runtime behavior.
record.title: Adopt the node lifecycle and the split-brain observation path
